title: Ichthyostega
summary: Ichthyostega is an early limbed vertebrate, known from Late Devonian rocks of East Greenland. It and Acanthostega lived an estimated 360-370 million years ago. Fossils were first found in the 1930s by Swedish-Danish expeditions, and later work on juveniles has changed ideas about how early tetrapods moved between water and land.

uncertainty.note: Range 360-370 million years ago as estimated by Duke University; the id's 365 is only a midpoint key.

where.historical_name: Not applicable (Late Devonian; no polity); proxy pin at Gauss Halvø, one of the East Greenland fossil localities

paleo.source: GPlates Web Service reconstruction of the pin

importance.justification: One of the earliest known limbed vertebrates, central to the story of vertebrates moving onto land.
